title: Add our notes to the flow map and review the prepared tasks: all work flows in through the same system (2026-10-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Look in the programme. We have a map of our flow, and a set of tasks that have been prepared .

We need to add in our notes, and review the tasks. We should make sure the we are flowing any work in through the same system.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-27; recorded verbatim. Context: Claude Code had found 120 open group items with about 6 ready, a programme-wide topup target of 6, 48 parked labels from one 10-08 sweep, 86 items without a technical plan, and proposed a per-group topup.
